lines.en: label springtime9:
scene wakanaresearchxmas1
: {i}The same reason I know everything else — I just do.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}跟我知道其他一切的原因一样——我就是知道。{/i}

lines.en: : Wakana, are you almost done yet? You’ve had your face buried in that stupid notebook all day.
lines.zh: : Wakana，你快好了吗？你一整天都把脸埋在那本破笔记本里。

lines.en: : Call poetry stupid again and I will slap you. And let me clarify that I will do it in a way that you will derive little to no sexual pleasure from.
lines.zh: : 你再敢说诗歌蠢，我就扇你。而且我先说清楚，我会用一种你几乎得不到任何性快感的方式扇。

lines.en: : I’m sure the poetry is {i}fine.{/i} But the notebook is stupid because it’s preventing us from spending Christmas together when we’re supposed to be out doing...you know. Couple stuff.
lines.zh: : 我确定诗歌是好的。可那本笔记本很蠢，因为它害我们不能一起过圣诞——我们本该出去做……你知道的。情侣的事。

lines.en: : And “couple stuff” we shall do, Osako. Just not yet.
lines.zh: : 「情侣的事」我们当然会做，Osako。只是不是现在。

lines.en: : Then when? Because I’ve been waiting all day and you’re not even dressed yet.
lines.zh: : 那是什么时候？我等了一整天，你连衣服都还没换。

lines.en: : In regard to the peony, how do you feel?
lines.zh: : 关于牡丹，你有什么感觉？

lines.en: : ...What?
: The peony. The flower. Does it elicit a specific emotion or take you back to a certain time in your life? What do you think it could represent? Love? Happiness? Beauty?
lines.zh: : 牡丹。那种花。它会唤起某种特定的情绪，或者把你带回人生的某段时光吗？你觉得它能代表什么？爱？幸福？美？

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas2
: Hah...those topics are so vague and broad that basically {i}anything{/i} could symbolize them if you spin it the right way. Or if you’re just...really persuasive or something.
lines.zh: : 哈……这些主题太空泛了，只要你换个说法，基本上任何东西都能象征它们。或者只要你……特别有说服力之类的。

lines.en: : Which is why I asked you how they make {i}you{/i} feel. Because I have all but numbed myself to the faux functions of flora these last few weeks.
lines.zh: : 所以我才问{i}你{/i}它们让你有什么感觉。因为这几周下来，我已经对花卉的那些伪功能彻底麻木了。

lines.en: : I’m aware. We haven’t even had sex this month and we used to average like...four times a day.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我们这个月连一次性生活都没有，以前我们平均……一天四次呢。

lines.en: : If it will make you feel any better, I’ll allow you to open one of your Christmas presents {i}before{/i} our date tonight. Probability dictates there may be something in one of them that could “assist” you.
lines.zh: : 如果能让你好受点，我允许你在今晚约会{i}之前{/i}先拆一个圣诞礼物。按概率来说，其中一个里面可能有什么能「帮」到你的东西。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas3
: Or, you know, {i}you{/i} could assist me. With your hands. Or your mouth. Or one of the million toys we keep in the closet. Hell, I’ll even take a foot at this point.
lines.zh: : 或者，{i}你{/i}知道的，你可以亲自来帮我。用你的手。或者你的嘴。或者我们柜子里那上百万个玩具里的任何一个。妈的，到这地步我连脚都认了。

lines.en: : Absolutely not. We tried that one time in college and vowed to never attempt it again. Restrain yourself, my pet.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。我们大学时试过一次，还发誓再也不尝试了。克制一点，我的小宠物。

lines.en: : Wakana, enough is enough. I get that this...research thing is important to you, but Christmas has always been a day for {i}us.{/i}
lines.zh: : Wakana，够了就是够了。我明白这个……研究对你很重要，可圣诞节一直都是属于{i}我们{/i}的日子。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas4
: Every day is a day for {i}us.{/i} That’s precisely what love is. But there will {i}be{/i} other Christmases. Many of them. And right now, I {i}have{/i} to do this.
lines.zh: : 每一天都是属于我们的日子。那正是爱的本质。但还会有别的圣诞节。很多个。而此刻，我必须做这件事。

lines.en: : But {i}why?{/i} Why {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可是为什么？为什么是现在？

lines.en: : Because I may be on the verge of losing something I...
lines.zh: : 因为我正在濒临失去某样我……

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas5
: Something I do not want to lose.
lines.zh: : 某样我不想失去的东西。

lines.en: : So I ask you to understand and bear with me for just a little while longer. Surely I must be getting close to {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以我请求你理解，再容忍我一小段时间。我肯定已经快要触到什么了。

lines.en: : Are you really that worried about him?
lines.zh: : 你真的那么担心他吗？

lines.en: : Would you not be worried if one of your closest associates suddenly vanished off the face of the earth? Additionally, if you think {i}I’m{/i} handling this poorly, I urge you to take a look at Imani.
lines.zh: : 如果你最亲近的同事之一突然从地球上消失，你会不担心吗？另外，如果你觉得{i}我{/i}处理得糟糕，我建议你去看看 Imani。

lines.en: : You realize he’s my friend too, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道他也是我的朋友吧？

lines.en: : Then why are you not as concerned as I am?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不像我这么担心？

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas6
: Because he’s a grown man, Wakana. He doesn’t need you to-
lines.zh: : 因为他是个成年人啊，Wakana。他不需要你——

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas7
: He is no typical {i}grown man,{/i} Osako! You have not seen the {i}fear{/i} in his eyes! You have not seen the way he {i}trembles{/i} at the mere {i}mention{/i} of-
lines.zh: : 他可不是什么普通的成年人，Osako！你没看到他眼里的恐惧！你没看到他光是听到……就浑身发抖的样子！

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas8
: Hah...I apologize. I didn’t mean to raise my voice. That was wrong of me. But {i}please{/i} know that Arakawa is far more complex than you know. And it’s not in a good way.
lines.zh: : 哈……抱歉。我不是有意提高嗓门。那样不对。但请你明白，Arakawa 远比你以为的复杂。而且那种复杂并不是好事。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas9
: There was a recurring subject in the early works of the Girl Who Cannot Breathe — a child known only as “Boy,” who is believed by most to be nothing more than a muse of sorts.
lines.zh: : 在「无法呼吸的女孩」早期作品里，有一个反复出现的主题——一个只被称作「男孩」的孩子，大多数人认为他不过是某种缪斯。

lines.en: : I know. You’ve told me a million times. Hell, I could probably write a whole report on that psycho at this point.
lines.zh: : 我知道。你跟我说过一百万遍了。妈的，到这地步我大概都能就那个疯子写一整篇报告了。

lines.en: : This “Boy” may not just be a muse, though. This boy-
lines.zh: : 不过这个「男孩」也许不只是个缪斯。这个男孩——

lines.en: : Could be Sensei. I know. You’ve made that very clear. But that woman was a total creep and it could have very well been literally any other {i}boy{/i} out there.
lines.zh: : 可能就是 Sensei。我知道。你说得很清楚了。可那个女人就是个彻头彻尾的变态，那也可能是外面任何一个{i}男孩{/i}。

lines.en: : If you were as confident as you sound, your “research” would be over already and we’d be off looking at Christmas lights together.
lines.zh: : 如果你真像你说的那么有把握，你的「研究」早就结束了，我们早就一起去看圣诞灯了。

lines.en: : But you’re {i}not{/i} confident. You’re just guessing. And guessing is all you’re ever going to do if no one else in the...obscure creepy poetry community has outed her as a criminal by now.
lines.zh: : 可你并不有把握。你只是在猜。而如果那个……冷门的变态诗歌圈里到现在都没人揭发她是罪犯，那你除了猜也做不了别的。

lines.en: : What would be the point in {i}outing{/i} her now? She vanished years ago. Around the same exact time Ami Arakawa lost her mother. Because she {i}was{/i} Ami Arakawa’s mother.
lines.zh: : 现在{i}揭发{/i}她又有什么意义？她多年前就消失了。恰好是在 Ami Arakawa 失去母亲的那段时间。因为她就是 Ami Arakawa 的母亲。

lines.en: : And she has passed her creepy poetry powers onto her daughter who is now going to grow up to also prey upon children. Right?
lines.zh: : 而她把她那套变态的诗才传给了她女儿，她女儿现在也会长大去捕食儿童。是吧？

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas10
: I do not like that mocking tone, Osako. This isn’t some supernatural battle against the will of a dead mother — it’s a kind-hearted effort to save two people who I see {i}every single day.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你这种嘲讽的语气，Osako。这不是什么对抗亡母遗志的超自然战役——这是一份善意，为了拯救两个我每天都见到的人。

lines.en: : Or rather, two people I {i}was{/i} seeing every day until spontaneous tragedy struck and thrust both of them into the indefinite darkness of Arakawa’s likely dingy home.
lines.zh: : 或者更准确地说，是两个我原本每天都见到的人，直到突发的悲剧降临，把他们俩一起推进了 Arakawa 那间大概很昏暗的家里、那片无尽的黑暗之中。

lines.en: : What’s the end goal, though? What is all of this researching going to do if you’re already sure that the creepy poet is Ami’s mom and Sensei is the kid she was taking advantage of?
lines.zh: : 可最终目的是什么？既然你已经确定那个变态诗人是 Ami 的妈妈、而 Sensei 就是她曾经利用的那个孩子，你做这些研究又能怎样？

lines.en: : Because it’s not like confirming that is going to give anybody peace of mind. And it’s not like just telling this Ami girl that her mom was psycho is going to {i}change{/i} her at all.
lines.zh: : 因为确认这一点并不会让任何人安心。而且光是告诉那个 Ami 姑娘她妈妈是个疯子，也不足以{i}改变{/i}她。

lines.en: : I read her poetry too, you know? {i}With{/i} you. Ami needs help, not...literary analysis.
lines.zh: : 我也读过她的诗，你知道吗？是和你一起读的。Ami 需要的是帮助，不是……文学分析。

lines.en: : The reason...I am being so analytical...is because I could have {i}predicted this...{/i}if I had only paid more attention.
lines.zh: : 我之所以……这么执着于分析……是因为如果我多留意一点，我本可以预见到这件事。

lines.en: : Oh boy, here we go again.
lines.zh: : 哦天啊，又来了。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas11
: The peony sleeps in its bed of unrest — ‘neath the fireflies' wings and their humble caress.
lines.zh: : 牡丹睡在它不安的床榻——在萤火虫的翅翼与谦卑的爱抚之下。

lines.en: : The end of an onset — the base of a nest — in a future so fertile; one loss acquiesced.
lines.zh: : 一场肇始的终结——一个巢的根基——在如此丰饶的未来里；一次失落被默许。

lines.en: : The plucking of feathers — stems torn from the soil. The egg might be old, but who says it has spoiled?
lines.zh: : 羽毛被拔落——茎被从土里扯出。蛋也许是陈的，可谁说它已经坏了？

lines.en: : To drink in its yolk; to bathe in its oil — makes this little girl squeal, lest the garden recoils.
lines.zh: : 啜饮它的蛋黄；沐浴它的油——让这小小的女孩尖叫，唯恐那座花园退缩。

lines.en: : This is about him. This poem is about Arakawa being torn away from where he’s {i}meant{/i} to be and thrown into some {i}prison{/i} for the sake of making a “little girl” happy. Isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这是关于他的。这首诗讲的是 Arakawa 被人从他本该在的地方拽走，扔进某座牢笼，只为让一个「小小的女孩」开心。不是吗？

lines.en: : And the “garden” is his classroom. No...his world. The people in it...The things he...enjoys? Maybe?
lines.zh: : 而「花园」就是他的教室。不……他的世界。里面的人……他喜欢的东西？也许？

lines.en: : Hell if I know. This is {i}your{/i} area of expertise. All the poets I like are a lot easier to understand.
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道。这是你的专业领域。我喜欢的那些诗人可好懂得多。

lines.en: : She wanted this, Osako. No...she {i}knew{/i} this was coming.
lines.zh: : 她想要这件事发生，Osako。不……她早就知道这会来。

lines.en: : There are seven other poems in here that could all mean the same thing, but there’s one element they all have in common that I can’t figure out.
lines.zh: : 这里还有另外七首诗，可能都指向同一件事，可它们有一个我怎么也想不通的共同点。

lines.en: : “One loss acquiesced.”
lines.zh: : 「一次失落被默许。」

lines.en: : What does that mean? What is she referring to when she says that? Because the only major {i}loss{/i} I can think of would be her mother. IE: Arakawa's alleged former “lover.”
lines.zh: : 这是什么意思？她说这个的时候指的是什么？因为我能想到的唯一重大的失落就是她母亲。也就是 Arakawa 名义上的前{i}恋人{/i}。

lines.en: : But why would the passing of Ami’s mother begin to affect Arakawa to such an extent {i}now?{/i} She should have passed years ago.
lines.zh: : 可为什么 Ami 母亲的离世会在{i}现在{/i}开始如此深刻地影响 Arakawa？她应该多年前就去世了。

lines.en: : Could he have lost something else? What? Who? Who or what else does he even care about? Why do I barely know anything about him despite all the time we’ve spent together?
lines.zh: : 他会不会还失去了别的什么？什么？谁？除了这些，他还真正在乎过谁、在乎过什么？为什么我们相处了这么久，我却几乎对他一无所知？

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas12
: Well, while you’re doing {i}that,{/i} I’m going to call Rika and see if she wants to come over so I don’t have to spend Christmas alone.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你继续弄那个吧，我去给 Rika 打电话，看她要不要过来，免得我一个人过圣诞。

lines.en: : One loss acquiesced...loss acquiesced...
lines.zh: : 一次失落被默许……失落被默许……

lines.en: : I’m almost there. I’ve almost got it.
lines.zh: : 我快到了。我快想通了。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas13
: Wakana...can you {i}please{/i} wrap this up soon? I’ve been trying to be supportive and haven’t complained at all since you started doing this since I know it’s important to you, but...
lines.zh: : Wakana……你能不能快点收尾？我一直很支持你，从你开始做这个起一句抱怨都没有，因为我知道这对你很重要，可是……

lines.en: : Today is different. Today, {i}I{/i} want to be the priority. And I can’t imagine a few hours will make a big difference in the grand scheme of...all you’ve been doing. Especially since you’re months in at this point.
lines.zh: : 今天不一样。今天，{i}我{/i}想成为你的优先事项。而且我不觉得区区几个小时能对你一直在做的那些事有什么大影响。尤其你都搞了好几个月了。

lines.en: : Yes. Fine. Just...go call Rika while I make a few more notes in- wait, has this always been here? Why have I not seen this poem before? Why are there no notations?
lines.zh: : 好。行。只是……你去给 Rika 打电话，我再记几笔——等等，这一直都在这儿吗？为什么我以前没见过这首诗？为什么没有任何批注？

lines.en: : I’ll be back in a couple minutes. {i}Please{/i} at least get dressed while I’m gone.
lines.zh: : 我几分钟后回来。我不在的时候，拜托至少把衣服换上。

lines.en: scene black
: My dress is in the dryer. Can you-
lines.zh: : 我的裙子在烘干机里。你能不能——

lines.en: : You can get it yourself.
lines.zh: : 你自己去拿。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas14
: {i}Hey, Osako! Merry Christmas! Unless you don’t celebrate Christmas. And if that’s the case, merry Wednesday!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘿，Osako！圣诞快乐！除非你不过圣诞节。那样的话，周三快乐！{/i}

lines.en: : It’s Friday, Rika.
lines.zh: : 今天是周五，Rika。

lines.en: : {i}Then merry that!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那就祝那个快乐！{/i}

lines.en: : John, stop! If you damage the Nao-chan with your chicken powers, I will never put another squirmy tubular creature in your mouth! And you love tubes!
lines.zh: : John，住手！你用你的鸡之力把 Nao-chan 弄坏了，我就再也不把蠕动的管状生物放进你嘴里了！而你最爱管子了！

lines.en: : {i}What’s that in the background?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}背景里那是什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Oh, those are just my neighbors. But hey, are you doing anything right now? Because Wakana’s being kind of...absent. And I could really use the company.
lines.zh: : 哦，那只是我的邻居。不过嘿，你现在有事吗？因为 Wakana 有点……心不在焉。而我真的需要有人陪。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas15
: Yeah! I’m totally free.
lines.zh: : 有啊！我完全有空。

lines.en: : What? No you’re not. We’re literally shopping right now. And you know how I feel about you inviting your friends into various dressing rooms with me.
lines.zh: : 什么？你没空。我们现在真的在逛街。而你知道我有多不喜欢你把你朋友拉进我和你共用的各种更衣室。

lines.en: : Rin’s excited to see you as well!
lines.zh: : Rin 也很想见到你呢！

lines.en: : Who is that?
lines.zh: : 那是谁？

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas16
: It’s Osako. Sounds like things aren’t going great with Wakana and she needs a new lesbian. I mean top. I mean girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 是 Osako。听起来她和 Wakana 之间不太顺，她需要一个新的拉拉。我是说攻。我是说女朋友。

lines.en: : {i}I’m still here, you know.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我还在这儿呢，你知道吗。{/i}

lines.en: : She says she’s still here.
lines.zh: : 她说她还在这儿。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t want any part of this until I can confirm that Miss Watabe won’t chop my head off. And also, you’re not free. You promised me clothes for Christmas and I have no money to pay for myself.
lines.zh: : 是啊，在确认 Watabe 老师不会把我的头砍下来之前，我一点也不想掺和。再说你没空啊。你答应过给我买圣诞衣服，而我一分钱都没有。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas17
: Sorry, Osako. Rin’s afraid of Wakana and I have to buy her clothes. But I’m sure nobody will mind if we just keep talking on the phone even though I’m in a public place with a lot of people.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，Osako。Rin 怕 Wakana，我还得给她买衣服。不过我敢肯定没人介意我们继续讲电话，哪怕我在一个有很多人的公共场所。

lines.en: : I should’ve figured as much. Looks like I really {i}am{/i} the only person alone on Christmas this year.
lines.zh: : 我早该料到。看来今年圣诞节我是真的只有一个人了。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas18
: I feel like that is statistically improbable.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这在统计上不太可能。

lines.en: : I feel like some of those words were too big for you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得有些词对你来说太难了。

lines.en: : Just give me a couple hours and we can chill if you’re still not doing anything. Rin’s got a Christmas party later, so I’m free once she heads over there.
lines.zh: : 给我几个小时，你要是还没事做，我们可以一起玩。Rin 晚点要去圣诞派对，等她过去了我就有空。

lines.en: : But, then again, I guess there’s always a chance she decides to bail since her ex is going to be there and that would be like, totally awkward for them. Right? Hahahah!
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，她也有可能临时放鸽子，毕竟她前女友也会在那儿，那对她们来说会超级尴尬。对吧？哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Like, can you {i}imagine{/i} ever being in the same room with your ex again after they leave you? Things like that just don’t happen, right? Like, it’s not a thing anyone should get their hopes up for or whatever?
lines.zh: : 比如说，你能想象在对方甩了你之后，还和她同处一室吗？这种事根本不会发生，对吧？就像，谁都不该对这种事抱什么期待之类的？

lines.en: : It was mutual! And it happened over a month ago! And stop feeling so sorry for yourself all the time!
lines.zh: : 那是双方同意的！而且是一个多月前的事了！还有别老是自怨自艾的！

lines.en: : Sorry, Rin. Can’t hear you. I’m going through a tunnel.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Rin。听不见。我正在过隧道。

lines.en: : I can literally see you!
lines.zh: : 我都能看见你本人好吗！

lines.en: : Did you forget which one of us you’re on the phone with?
lines.zh: : 你忘了你在跟我们中的哪一个讲电话吗？

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas19
: But hey, if the bar’s open tonight and you two don’t want to be alone, maybe the three of us could go out for drinks?
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，如果今晚酒吧开着，而你们俩不想独处，也许我们三个可以出去喝一杯？

lines.en: : Or maybe if you {i}do{/i} want to be alone but with an additional person who may also be open to getting some Christmas action, we could do that instead!
lines.zh: : 或者如果你想独处、但愿意多一个也许也想来点圣诞{i}运动{/i}的人，我们也可以改成那样！

lines.en: : Uhh...ew?
: Don’t mind Rin if you just heard her. She doesn’t like girls anymore now that she’s been dumped by one.
lines.zh: : 你要是听到 Rin 的话别理她。她被女生甩了之后就不喜欢女生了。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas20
: Stop making all your friends think I was dumped! And also, I still like girls! Which is a thing I probably shouldn’t be yelling in a dressing room, but it’s the truth! And I will not remain silent!
lines.zh: : 别再让你所有朋友以为我是被甩的！还有，我依然喜欢女生！这种事我大概不该在更衣室里大喊，可这是事实！而且我不会保持沉默！

lines.en: : Hey, so apparently Rin wants in on the Christmas action too. Do you know any good ways to tell your daughter they need to stay out of your sex life?
lines.zh: : 嘿，看来 Rin 也想加入圣诞「运动」。你知道有什么好办法告诉女儿，让她别插手你的性生活吗？

lines.en: : It would help by not yelling things that force her to get involved whether she wants to or not! Which she doesn’t because you’re old and gross!
lines.zh: : 那就别大喊大叫，逼得她不管想不想都得掺和进来！她可不想，因为你又老又恶心！

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas21
: But not you, Osako! You’re pretty! And only kind of old!
lines.zh: : 但你不是，Osako！你很漂亮！而且只是有点老！

lines.en: : Rin says you’re pretty. Now, we must fight.
lines.zh: : Rin 说你很漂亮。现在，我们必须打一架。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas22
: Yeah, instead of that, how about I just let you go and...give you a call later if I’m still not doing anything?
lines.zh: : 嗯，别这样了，我就先挂了……要是我之后还没事做，再打给你？

lines.en: : You sure? Because I don’t mind staying on the phone a little longer.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？我不介意再多讲一会儿。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure. I want to go back in and check on Wakana anyway.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我确定。反正我也想进去看看 Wakana 怎么样了。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas23
: She still taking the Sensei thing as badly as Imani has been?
lines.zh: : 她对 Sensei 那件事，还是跟 Imani 一样看不开吗？

lines.en: : That’s...not a thing I want to get into right now. I’ll call you later.
lines.zh: : 那个……我现在不想谈。我晚点打给你。

lines.en: : Kay. Talk to you then. Let me know if you need anything.
lines.zh: : 好的。那就到时候聊。需要什么就跟我说。

lines.en: : Yeah...bye.
lines.zh: : 嗯……再见。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas24
: That was Osako.
lines.zh: : 那是 Osako。

lines.en: : I know who it was, Mom.
lines.zh: : 我知道那是谁，妈。

lines.en: : Are you still upset too?
lines.zh: : 你也还在难过吗？

lines.en: : I already told you. It was mutual.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说过了。那是双方同意的。

lines.en: : You know that’s not what I mean.
lines.zh: : 你知道我不是指这个。

lines.en: : Do you want to talk about it?
lines.zh: : 你想聊聊吗？

lines.en: : You haven’t been doing anything stupid, have you?
lines.zh: : 你没在做什么傻事吧？
: 没有……

lines.en: : Are you lying to me?
lines.zh: : 你在骗我吗？
: 没有……

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas25
: I like you as a blonde. You look cool.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你金发的样子。你看起来很酷。

lines.en: : Thanks. But just so you know, there’s nothing less cool than being called “cool” by your uncool mom.
lines.zh: : 谢了。不过先说清楚，被一个不酷的妈妈说「酷」，是最不酷的事了。

lines.en: : We’re in private. No one’s going to care.
lines.zh: : 这里是私人空间。没人会在意的。

lines.en: : Which is why I want to tell you the same thing I told Osako just now. Let me know if you need anything. Okay?
lines.zh: : 所以我想跟你说跟 Osako 刚才一样的话。需要什么就跟我说。好吗？

lines.en: : Rin. Look at me.
lines.zh: : Rin。看着我。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas26
: Why? Are you trying to embarrass me on purpose right now or something?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你是故意要让我难堪还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Of course not. I just love you. And I want you to know that even if I’m kind of an idiot and not a great mom...that won’t ever change.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。我只是爱你。我想让你知道，就算我有点蠢、不是个好妈妈……那也永远不会变。

lines.en: scene wakanaresearchxmas27
: “I love you too, Mom! You’re so awesome and pretty and only 42 years old!”
lines.zh: : 「我也爱你，妈妈！你太棒了又漂亮，而且才 42 岁！」

lines.en: : You’re 43...
scene black
: And now {i}we{/i} must fight as well! Mwahahaha!
lines.zh: : 那么现在{i}我们{/i}也得打一架了！哇哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Wha- get off of me! I’m half naked!
lines.zh: : 什——放开我！我衣服都没穿好！

lines.en: : Never! You’re my daughter and I’ll attack you in the dressing room if I-
lines.zh: : 绝不！你是我女儿，我就要在更衣室里袭击你，如果

lines.en: : Okay. That’s it. You two have been in here for half an hour and have not shut up even once. It’s time to go.
lines.zh: : 好了。够了。你们俩在这儿待了半小时，一刻都没停过。该走了。

lines.en: : Attack!
lines.zh: : 进攻！

lines.en: : Mom! You can't attack the employees!
lines.zh: : 妈！你不能袭击店员！

{i}Rin’s affection has decayed by 10!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度下降了 10！{/i}
